sentences.englishText: Alfred Hitchcock was a famous film director who was born in London in 1899.
sentences.turkishText: Alfred Hitchcock 1899'da Londra'da doğan ünlü bir film yönetmeniydi.

sentences.englishText: He moved to Hollywood and made many successful films including Psycho and The Birds.
sentences.turkishText: Hollywood'a taşındı ve Psycho ve Kuşlar dahil birçok başarılı film yaptı.

sentences.englishText: Queen Elizabeth made him a Sir in 1980, and he died in Los Angeles shortly after.
sentences.turkishText: Kraliçe Elizabeth 1980'de ona "Sir" unvanı verdi ve o kısa bir süre sonra Los Angeles'ta öldü.

enrichment.summary: Alfred Hitchcock was a famous film director who was born in London in 1899. He moved to Hollywood and made many successful films including Psycho and The Birds.
